states: Install Pulse Agent (Linux, macOS, Windows host): 'Allow Pulse to run commands on this host' checkbox visible in step 1 under the token summary, before any token exists, unchecked by default, with its root-access description

Token summary bullet reads 'Monitoring only. Pulse cannot run commands or change containers on this host.' when unchecked and 'Pulse can run commands as root on this host, including container updates and Patrol actions.' when checked
Advanced connection and install options now hold only the Agent URL, CA, TLS and profile controls; the only other checkbox there is Skip TLS certificate verification
Docker installer: the Docker inside Proxmox LXCs note names the new option and the Proxmox VE node profile; no horizontal overflow at 375 px
Proxmox VE Host Telemetry Agent guide: the Docker-in-LXC note names 'Allow Pulse to run commands on this host'

The 'installed without command access' pill variant cannot render on mock data (no mock docker-host carries an agent facet); its copy is covered by containerUpdateBadgeModel and ContainerUpdateBadge tests
interactions: Opened Settings, Infrastructure, Add infrastructure, Install Pulse Agent
Ticked the option before generating a token, then generated one: toast confirmed command execution permission and every install command carried --enable-commands or PULSE_ENABLE_COMMANDS
Unticked it afterwards: token regenerated without command execution, toast told the user to copy the command again, no install command carried the flag
Opened the advanced options and listed their checkboxes
Opened the Docker installer at the mobile viewport and scrolled to the option
Opened the Proxmox VE flow and chose Host Telemetry Agent
